title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: Expresses concern over the Bulgarian Government
part_context: Expresses concern over the Bulgarian Government’s ambiguous response to the Russian threat; regrets the weak diplomatic response of the Bulgarian Government towards the Russian Federation and calls on the Member States to coordinate their diplomatic action; calls on Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev to match demands for allied solidarity with concrete action; deplores Bulgaria’s delayed participation in NATO’s Air Defence Capabilities Against Lower-level Air Threats initiative (NATO’s anti-drone initiative) and urges the Bulgarian Government not to delay further but to formally confirm its participation by 30 October 2026;
